title: NFPA - free public-education and research documents
rights_note: NFPA copyright. Published free and intended for redistribution (safety tip sheets exist to be printed and handed out; FPRF research is open access). Attribute NFPA. Do not resell as our own content.

refresh.note: Tip sheets refresh around Fire Prevention Week (October); FPRF publishes continuously.

description: 737 documents: safety tip sheets, lesson plans, fact sheets, checklists (English and Spanish), and Fire Protection Research Foundation + NFPA Research reports. NFPA's licensed standards (nfpa-ibr) are deliberately NOT a pack and are out of scope.
